lines.japanese: 「えー、というわけで玉泉君。うっかり君には報告を忘れていたが、鷲介にはうっかりこの店を手伝ってもらうことになった」
lines.english: “And so, Tamaizumi. I happened to forget to tell you, but Shusuke also happens to be joining the staff here.”

lines.japanese: 「彼の出勤日は都合により本人の任意だが、入ってもらう日には、だいたいこのぐらいの時間からクローズまでいてもらうことになる」
lines.english: “His shifts will be at his discretion, as circumstances allow. Whenever he does come in, he'll generally work from around this time until closing.”

lines.japanese: 「基本はフロア担当だが、フロアの手が足りていれば他の持ち場へ臨機応変に配してゆくつもりだ。まあ、知ってのとおり彼は粗忽者だが、我々の業務はチームワークが大事だ。仲良くしてやってくれたまえ」
lines.english: “He'll primarily work the floor, though if the floor is adequately staffed, I intend to deploy him elsewhere as circumstances require. As you know, he is a careless fellow, but our work depends upon teamwork. Do try to get along with him.”

lines.japanese: マスターが改めて俺の紹介をしている間じゅう、日和子さんはずっと、温かみのない眼差しをこちらに向けておられました。
lines.english: Throughout the boss's renewed introduction, Hiyoko kept a decidedly cold gaze fixed on me.

lines.japanese: 俺はそんな眼光にもめげず……や、実は結構めげてるんですけど、めげてない振りをして活気に満ちた挨拶をしました。
lines.english: Undaunted by that glare—or rather, quite thoroughly daunted but pretending otherwise—I delivered a greeting brimming with vigor.

lines.japanese: 「ち、千歳鷲介です！　心持ち期待の中型新人です！　以後よろしくお願いします！」
lines.english: “I-I'm Shusuke Chitose! The mildly anticipated, medium-caliber rookie! I look forward to working with you!”

lines.japanese: すると日和子さんは、ふっと首ごと目線をどこか斜め下に落として──
lines.english: At that, Hiyoko dipped her whole head and cast her eyes down and aside—

lines.japanese: 「よろしくおねがいします」
lines.english: “Likewise.”

lines.japanese: ──よろしくされたかなさそうな声色でつぶやきました。
lines.english: —and murmured it in a tone that sounded remarkably reluctant to do anything of the kind.

lines.japanese: 彼女のそんな様子を目の当たりにして、マスターはいつものシリアス少年漫画のような口調で俺に問いかけました。
lines.english: At the sight of her, the boss addressed me in his usual deadly serious comic-book-hero voice.

lines.japanese: 「鷲介、俺の気のせいかもしれんが……なにやらこの一帯、敵意にも似た不穏な邪気を感じないか？」
lines.english: “Shusuke, perhaps it is only my imagination... but do you not sense a sinister aura in these parts, something very like hostility?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、感じるも何も見たまんまじゃないすか」
lines.english: “There's nothing to sense. It's written all over her face.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと？　よもや、またしても玉泉君の機嫌を損ねるような失態を犯したのか」
lines.english: “What? Surely you haven't blundered yet again and offended Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: 「はい。アナタがね。またしてもアナタがね」
lines.english: “Yes. You did. Once again, you did.”

lines.japanese: 聞けば例のロッカーは、昨日まで日和子さんが使っていたものだったそうです。
lines.english: It emerged that Hiyoko had used that locker until yesterday.

lines.japanese: なのに、今日から新戦力加入にともなって配置変えになったことが、マスターのありがちなうっかりで彼女には伝わっていなかったということです。
lines.english: But with a new recruit arriving today, the lockers had been reassigned, and in one of the boss's customary lapses he had neglected to tell her.

lines.japanese: しかし真相が発覚してもなお、彼女は俺へ向けた剣先を下ろしてはくれません。
lines.english: Even after the truth came to light, she kept the point of that sword aimed squarely at me.

lines.japanese: 畏れ多くも新人の分際で言わせていただけるなら──
lines.english: If I, a mere rookie, might presume to say one thing—

lines.japanese: そんなん俺のせいじゃねえよ。
lines.english: That wasn't my damn fault.

lines.japanese: ──言えませんけどね。初日だし。ぺーぺーだし。相手、日和子さんだし。
lines.english: —Not that I could say it. First day. Bottom rung. And it was Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「ほう……では鷲介よ、おまえには完全に非がないと申すか」
lines.english: “Ah... Then you claim, Shusuke, that you bear absolutely no fault?”

lines.japanese: 「な、ないですよ」
lines.english: “N-none.”

lines.japanese: ぞっとするほど冷たかった日和子さんの目が、きっ、と火花を散らすように燃えあがりました。
lines.english: Hiyoko's eyes, cold enough to chill the blood, suddenly blazed with sparks.

lines.japanese: 「あるみたいだぞ」
lines.english: “Apparently you do.”

lines.japanese: 「うそーん」
lines.english: “No waaaay.”

lines.japanese: 俺はしょぼくれた仔犬のように鳴いてマスターの背中に隠れました。
lines.english: I whimpered like a dejected puppy and hid behind the boss's back.

lines.japanese: しかし軽部氏は、俺と彼女のそんな一触即発ぶりを察していながら平然と言うのです。
lines.english: Yet Mr. Karube, perfectly aware that Hiyoko and I stood one spark from detonation, continued with complete composure.

lines.japanese: 「ところで玉泉君。仕事の話に戻るのだが、君を千歳鷲介の教育係に任命する」
lines.english: “By the way, Tamaizumi. Returning to business, I hereby appoint you as Shusuke Chitose's trainer.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: それはとても大きな声──ていうか、すでに悲鳴でした。こんなに分かりやすい嫌われ方は久しぶりです。思わず俺も聞こえよがしな泣き言を漏らしていました。
lines.english: That was loud—actually, it was already a scream. It had been a long time since anyone had disliked me quite so openly. I found myself whining just loudly enough for her to hear.

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、日和子さんったら、なんて感情を隠せないひとなんだろう」
lines.english: “Wow, Hiyoko. You really don't hide how you feel, do you?”

lines.japanese: 「うむ。おそらくベッドでも凄いのだろうな」
lines.english: “Indeed. I imagine she is remarkable in bed as well.”

lines.japanese: ばんっ！
lines.english: Bang!

lines.japanese: 日和子さんがカウンターテーブルの上に平手を貼りつけて俺を睨んでいます。
lines.english: Hiyoko slapped one palm down on the counter and glared at me.

lines.japanese: 「違うこっち！　いまの発言こっち！」
lines.english: “Wrong one! He's the one who said it!”

lines.japanese: 俺は慌ててセクハラ上司の体を前に押しだしましたが、いまさら彼女の気色ばんだ表情は和らぎません。
lines.english: I hurriedly shoved my sexually harassing superior forward, but it was far too late to soothe her outraged expression.

lines.japanese: 「店長」
lines.english: “Boss.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、玉泉トレーナー」
lines.english: “What is it, Coach Tamaizumi?”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんの苗字には、早くも新たな役職名がくっついていました。
lines.english: Her surname had acquired a brand-new title already.

lines.japanese: 「そのお話、慎んで辞退させていただきます」
lines.english: “I must respectfully decline that assignment.”

lines.japanese: 言葉ばかりで、慎みのかけらも見られない確答でした。
lines.english: The deference was all in her wording. The refusal itself was absolute.

lines.japanese: 「なぜだ。なにか問題でもあるのか」
lines.english: “Why? Is there some problem?”

lines.japanese: 「きわめて」
lines.english: “A very serious one.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、もっと自信を持ちなさい。君は仕事も出来るし、勤務態度も良好だ。問題などない」
lines.english: “Ha ha! Have more confidence in yourself. You're good at your job and your work ethic is exemplary. There is no problem at all.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、私にではなく」
lines.english: “No. I didn't mean me.”

lines.japanese: 「なに。それでは何者に問題があると言うのだ」
lines.english: “What? Then who is the problem?”

lines.japanese: 俺は居たたまれなくなって、日和子さんの口から残酷な回答が飛びだす前に割って入りました。
lines.english: Unable to bear it, I cut in before the cruel answer could leap from Hiyoko's lips.

lines.japanese: 「あのう、マスター、その件に関しては自分からも再考を要求──」
lines.english: “Um, boss, on that point I'd also like to formally request reconsideration—”

lines.japanese: 「そうか分かった！　玉泉君は千歳鷲介が嫌い嫌い大嫌いなんだ！」
lines.english: “I understand! Tamaizumi hates Shusuke Chitose—hates him, hates him, hates his guts!”

lines.japanese: 「いやーっ、やめてーっ、はっきり言わないでーっ」
lines.english: “No! Stop! Don't spell it out!”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ……そこまでは申しませんが……」
lines.english: “N-no... I wouldn't go quite that far...”
“But?”

lines.japanese: 「が……その、私とは相容れないタイプの方だと思います」
lines.english: “But... I do think he's the kind of person I simply can't get along with.”

lines.japanese: 「おいっ、聞いたか鷲介。喜べ、はっきり嫌いだとは言われなかったぞ。つまり、おまえの子を孕んでも構わんという意味だ」
lines.english: “Did you hear that, Shusuke? Rejoice! She did not say outright that she hates you. In other words, she would not object to bearing your child.”

lines.japanese: 「や、そんな、社交上最低限の婉曲表現をノンストップで拡大解釈してもらっても」
lines.english: “Please don't take the bare minimum of polite evasion and expand it that far without even pausing for breath.”

lines.japanese: 「すみませんが、そういうことですので。それでは仕事に入ります」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, but that is how matters stand. Now, I have work to do.”

lines.japanese: 話をしてたのはマスターの方なのに、日和子さんは勝手にミーティングを打ちきって、客席の並ぶフロアへと姿を消してしまいました。
lines.english: Although the boss had begun the conversation, Hiyoko unilaterally adjourned the meeting and disappeared into the dining room.

lines.japanese: 遠巻きに見ていたらしい英里子さんが、そのメイド服の背中へ呆れまじりの冷笑を送っていました。
lines.english: Eriko, who had apparently watched from a distance, aimed an exasperated smirk at Hiyoko's retreating back.

lines.japanese: 次いで俺の方を向いて、厳しい表情で顎をくいっと右に振りぬきました。
lines.english: Then she faced me, set her features sternly, and jerked her chin sharply to the right.

lines.japanese: おめーも男だったらガツンと言ったれや、ちゅーとこでしょうか。
lines.english: If you call yourself a man, get over there and tell her what's what. Something like that.
NO WAY!

lines.japanese: というジェスチャーを返して、俺は逃げるようにマスターとの会話を再開しました。
lines.english: I answered with a gesture of my own, then retreated into my conversation with the boss.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、改めて何なんですけど……どーゆーひとなんすか日和子さんって」
lines.english: “Um, let me ask you again... What sort of person is Hiyoko, exactly?”

lines.japanese: 「見ての通りだ。なかなか胸がでかい」
lines.english: “As you can see, her breasts are quite large.”

lines.japanese: 「や、身体的特徴ではなく」
lines.english: “I meant something besides her physical attributes.”

lines.japanese: 「む、なるほど。目に見えるものが必ずしも真実とは限らない、そう言いたいわけだな」
lines.english: “Ah, I see. What the eye perceives is not necessarily the truth—that is your point.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ……たしかに、あのスマートな体であれだけ豊満な乳房を有しているのは不自然だ。ううむ、便利な時代だからな、なんらかの卑劣な手段を弄している可能性はある」
lines.english: “Hmm… It is indeed unnatural for so slender a body to possess breasts of such abundance. We live in an age of wonders; she may have resorted to some underhanded artifice.”

lines.japanese: んー、いや……たぶん、あのやーらかい感触は実力だったと思うけどなあ……。
lines.english: Hmm, no… I was fairly sure that soft, yielding feel was the real thing…

lines.japanese: 「どうした鷲介、貴様なぜてのひらを見る」
lines.english: “What is it, Shusuke? Why are you staring at your palms?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いえ、ちょっと今日の運勢を」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Just checking my fortune for today.”

lines.japanese: 「女難の相でも出ているんじゃないか」
lines.english: “Perhaps your palm foretells calamity at the hands of women.”

lines.japanese: 「あはー、そのようですなー」
lines.english: “Ah-ha. So it would seem.”

lines.japanese: 俺は顔を上げて、働く日和子さんの姿を目で追いました。
lines.english: I looked up and watched Hiyoko at work.

lines.japanese: 彼女はきびきびとした動作で、お客さんが帰ったあとのテーブルを片付けています。
lines.english: She moved briskly as she cleared a vacated table.

lines.japanese: ランチタイムとディナータイムに挟まれたこの時間帯、さほど混んでるわけでもないのにどこか忙しそうで、なんというか殺伐とした印象さえ受ける気がします。
lines.english: It was the lull between lunch and dinner, and the restaurant was hardly crowded. Yet something about her gave even the room a harried, almost grim air.

lines.japanese: そんな彼女の仕事ぶりを俺と一緒に見守っていたマスターが、不意にまともな回答をよこしました。
lines.english: As the boss watched her work beside me, he suddenly gave me a straight answer.

lines.japanese: 「玉泉君か。そうだな……俺の印象としては、厳しいやつだな」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi? Let me see... I'd say she's strict.”

lines.japanese: 「厳しい、ですか」
lines.english: “Strict?”

lines.japanese: 「たとえば、無人島に信号があったとしても彼女はそれを守るんじゃないかと思う」
lines.english: “I suspect that even if she found a traffic light on a desert island, she would obey it.”

lines.japanese: 「キビシィーっ！」
lines.english: “Striiiict!”

lines.japanese: 「もちろん俺の知るかぎりだがな」
lines.english: “Mind you, that's only what I've seen of her.”

lines.japanese: 「人間なんて、外から見てすべて認識できるほど単純なものじゃない。服を剥いでみれば意外な体をしてる女が多いようにな」
lines.english: “Human beings are not so simple that the eye can comprehend them in full. Just as many a woman reveals a surprising figure once you strip off her clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「やつだってああ見えて意外に、タイムカードを押したあと隙を見て居眠りするような要領の良さを隠しもっているかもしれんぞ」
lines.english: “For all you know, she may secretly have the cunning to punch her timecard and then nap whenever no one is looking.”

lines.japanese: 「にいさん、やなこと言いますね」
lines.english: “That's a rotten thing to say, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか？　誉めたつもりなんだがな。俺はそういう人間味のあるやつの方が可愛いと思うぞ」
lines.english: “Is it? I meant it as praise. I find people with that kind of human weakness more endearing.”

lines.japanese: 「ではお言葉に甘えて、自分は要領よくサボりながらやっていきます」
lines.english: “Then I'll take you at your word and master the art of slacking off.”

lines.japanese: 「屁理屈はいい。さあ、おまえも仕事を始めろ」
lines.english: “Enough of the sophistry. Now get to work.”

lines.japanese: 「かしこまりました」
lines.english: “At once.”

lines.japanese: 「えーと、ではまず何を？」
lines.english: “So, what should I do first?”

lines.japanese: 「知らん。担当の教育係に聞け」
lines.english: “How should I know? Ask the woman assigned to train you.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: マスターが指差した先には、背筋を伸ばし颯爽とフロアを横切るウェイトレスがひとり。
lines.english: The boss's pointing finger led me to a waitress striding smartly across the floor with her back perfectly straight.

lines.japanese: 「い、いやしかし、玉泉トレーナーはたったいま辞任願いを……」
lines.english: “B-but Coach Tamaizumi handed in her resignation only moments ago...”

lines.japanese: 「受理した覚えはない」
lines.english: “I do not recall accepting it.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー」
lines.english: “Come on!”

lines.japanese: 「本部の意向により、当店では新人スタッフに必ずひとり先輩アルバイトを付けることになっている。玉泉君や日野君とて、かつては望月君の指導のもと数々の業務内容を身につけてきたのだ」
lines.english: “Head office requires us to pair every new hire with an experienced part-timer. Tamaizumi and Hino themselves learned the work under Mochizuki's instruction.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、じゃあ俺も紀奈子さんに教わりたーい」
lines.english: “Then I want Kinako to teach me toooo.”

lines.japanese: 「たわけ。彼女は明日を最後に店を離れるだろうが」
lines.english: “Fool. Tomorrow is her last day here.”

lines.japanese: 「にしたって、他にもまだ先輩スタッフはたくさんいらっしゃるじゃないですか。なんで選りにも選って日和子さんなんすか」
lines.english: “Even so, there are plenty of other experienced employees. Why, of all people, does it have to be Hiyoko?”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉君とおまえの勤務時間帯が近いからだ。他に理由があると思うか？」
lines.english: “Because your usual hours largely coincide. Can you imagine any other reason?”

lines.japanese: 「なんか、嫌がらせ的な意図が含まれてるように感じるんすけど」
lines.english: “I'm getting the distinct sense that deliberate harassment factors into this.”

lines.japanese: 「ばれちゃった」
lines.english: “You caught me.”

lines.japanese: 「自白、早っ！」
lines.english: “That was a quick confession!”

lines.japanese: 「ふん。しかし、ただの嫌がらせではないぞ。嫌がらせを越えた先に、お互い学ぶこと多かろうと思ってのことだ」
lines.english: “Hmph. This is no mere harassment. I believe both of you will learn a great deal once you make it through to the other side.”

lines.japanese: 「お互いねえ……」
lines.english: “Both of us, huh...”

lines.japanese: マスターの胡散臭い言葉を繰りかえしながら、我が教官の姿を目で追いました。玉泉トレーナーは他の女子スタッフとユニフォームが違うから見つけやすいです。
lines.english: Repeating the boss's dubious words, I followed my newly appointed instructor with my eyes. Coach Tamaizumi was easy to spot because her uniform differed from the other women's.

lines.japanese: じろり──
lines.english: A cold glare—

lines.japanese: 俺たちの視線に気付いて、日和子さんが睨みかえしてきました。美人のメンチは鋭さが際立って、かえって怖いものです。
lines.english: Noticing our attention, Hiyoko glared back. A beautiful woman's dirty look has an especially sharp edge, which only makes it more frightening.

lines.japanese: 「あのう、マスター」
lines.english: “Um, boss.”

lines.japanese: おもに顔を側める目的で、俺は雇用主へ向きなおりました。
lines.english: Mostly for the sake of looking anywhere else, I turned back to my employer.

lines.japanese: 「白状します。実は俺こう見えて、ひとに嫌われるのすっごい苦手なんです」
lines.english: “I confess. You might not guess it from looking at me, but I really can't stand being hated.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、安心しろ。そんなの平気な人間なんているわけがない」
lines.english: “Ha ha! Take heart. Nobody likes being hated.”

lines.japanese: 「や、それ何のフォローにもなってませんよ」
lines.english: “That doesn't make me feel any better.”

lines.japanese: 「たわけ。彼女とて、ひとの痛みは分かるやつだと言っているんだ。なあに、おまえの一連の行為が悪意なきものだったと伝われば、すぐに態度を改め股を開くだろうよ」
lines.english: “Fool. I am saying that she, too, can understand another person's pain. Once she realizes there was no malice in any of your actions, she will soon change her tune and spread her legs for you.”

lines.japanese: 「だからにいさん、アナタが軽々しくそういう三段跳びのポジティブ・シンキングを口にするから、俺は日和子さんに──」
lines.english: “This is exactly what I mean. You toss out that sort of triple-jump positive thinking, and then Hiyoko takes it out on me—”

lines.japanese: ──じろり。
lines.english: —Another cold glare.

lines.japanese: 自分の名前が耳に届いたのか、対角線上でテーブルを拭いていた日和子さんが、またもこっちを訝しげに睨んでいます。
lines.english: Perhaps her name had reached her ears. Across the room, Hiyoko paused in wiping a table and once more eyed us suspiciously.

lines.japanese: 「ど、どーもぉ」
lines.english: “H-hi there.”

lines.japanese: へらへら笑いながら頭を下げる新人アルバイト。
lines.english: I bowed with an ingratiating grin—the very picture of the new hire.

lines.japanese: 「任せたぞう玉泉君！」
lines.english: “He's all yours, Tamaizumi!”

lines.japanese: その後ろで力強くうなずく店長。
lines.english: Behind me, the manager nodded with tremendous confidence.

lines.japanese: そして──
lines.english: And then—
“Haaaaah...”

lines.japanese: テーブルに両手をつき、観念したように首を９０度下へ折りまげたウェイトレス。
lines.english: The waitress planted both hands on the table and let her head hang a full ninety degrees in surrender.

lines.japanese: ばっさり下りた髪で表情が隠れているさまは、あたかもサスペンスドラマのわけあり殺人犯みたいでした。
lines.english: With her face hidden behind the fall of her hair, she looked like a killer with a dark past in some television murder mystery.

lines.japanese: 「鷲介、おまえにも頼むぞ。あきらめずに辛抱強く見守ってやってくれ」
lines.english: “I'm counting on you too, Shusuke. Don't give up on her. Be patient with her.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、あの、教育していただくのは俺の方なんですけど……」
lines.english: “Um, I'm supposed to be the one receiving instruction...”

lines.japanese: マスターに文字通り背中を押され、俺はおそるおそる玉泉トレーナーのもとへ向かいました。
lines.english: The boss literally pushed me from behind, and I made my cautious way over to Coach Tamaizumi.

lines.japanese: 「あのう、えーとー……」
lines.english: “Um, well...”

lines.japanese: 「マスターには俺からも言ってみたんですけどー、どうしてもトレーナーは日和子さんじゃなきゃ駄目だって言うんですよー……」
lines.english: “I tried talking to the boss myself, but he insists no one but you can train me...”

lines.japanese: うな垂れている日和子先輩の正面に立つと、ぺーぺーの俺はもう兎にも角にも頭を下げるしかありません。
lines.english: Standing before the dejected Hiyoko, I was the greenest of rookies and had no choice but to bow.

lines.japanese: 「というわけなので……ふ、ふつつか者ですが、よろしくご指導ご鞭撻のほどお願い申しあげます」
lines.english: “So... I know I have a great deal to learn, but I humbly place myself in your capable hands.”

lines.japanese: 恨めしげなふたつの眼光が、すだれみたいに垂れた前髪の隙間から無言でマスターを射抜いていました。
lines.english: Two resentful eyes silently pierced the boss through the gaps in her curtain of bangs.

lines.japanese: おっかないです。ほんと、おっかないです。せっかくのべっぴんさんなんですから、せめて優しく微笑んでいただきたいものです。
lines.english: Terrifying. Truly terrifying. She had such a lovely face; couldn't she at least favor me with a gentle smile?

lines.japanese: ええ、ほんと。また、あの、見てるこっちが楽しくなるような笑顔をもう一度見せていただきたいものです。
lines.english: Honestly. I wanted to see that smile again—the one that made me happy just to look at it.

lines.japanese: 「おーい玉泉君、うちは職場いじめ禁止だからなー」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi! Workplace bullying is prohibited here!”

lines.japanese: 割って入ってきたのは、カウンターから様子を窺っていたマスターの声。
lines.english: The boss's voice cut in from the counter, where he had been watching us.

lines.japanese: 「公私混同はいかんぞ、どんなわだかまりがあろうと職場では仲良くな。だがしかし、仲良くなり過ぎるときは忘れず俺も呼んでくれよ、はっはっはっ」
lines.english: “You must not mix private grievances with professional affairs. Whatever resentment lies between you, get along at work. If you begin getting along too well, however, don't forget to invite me! Ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: おやおや。図らずも再会できましたよ、日和子さんの笑顔。
lines.english: Well, well. Against all odds, there it was again: Hiyoko's smile.

lines.japanese: や、ものっそい空気不穏だけど、笑顔は笑顔……ですよねアレ。
lines.english: The air around her was extraordinarily ominous, but a smile was a smile... wasn't it?

lines.japanese: 「ふふ……ふふふふ……」
lines.english: “Heh heh... heh heh heh...”

lines.japanese: ほ、ほら、肩とか揺れてるし！
lines.english: S-see? Her shoulders were shaking and everything!

lines.japanese: 笑ってます、笑ってます！　ええ、もう、吹っきったと言うか吹っきれたと言うか、脱力感に満ちたステキな微笑みです。
lines.english: She was laughing! Definitely laughing! What a lovely smile, brimming with exhaustion—as if some final thread had snapped and set her free.

lines.japanese: 「そうですよね公私混同はよくないですよね！」
lines.english: “Quite right! Mixing private affairs with work would be terribly improper!”

lines.japanese: いきなり日和子さんが顔を上げました。ほうら笑顔だ、めっちゃ硬いけど！
lines.english: Hiyoko suddenly raised her face. See? A smile—though hard enough to crack stone!

lines.japanese: 「こちらこそよろしくおねがいしますねちとせさん！」
lines.english: “I look forward to working with you too, Mr. Chitose!”

lines.japanese: 殺してますねえ。いやあ、かなり殺してますねえ感情。
lines.english: She was holding it in, all right. Oh yes. Strangling every last trace of emotion with remarkable thoroughness.

lines.japanese: ま、ゼロからのスタートってことで？　逆に、これ以上は下がりようないっつー発想の転換で？　すぱっと開きなおっていきますか？
lines.english: Well, we were starting from scratch. Looked at another way, there was nowhere lower to fall. Maybe it was time to accept that and move on.

lines.japanese: おっし！　さあ、アゲてこうアゲてこう！
lines.english: All right! Come on—chin up, chin up!

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん。お客様の前でにやにやしない」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose. Do not grin in front of the customers.”

lines.japanese: 「す、すいません……」
lines.english: “S-sorry...”
